name: bootstrap-approvals
description: Repo-agnostic Antigravity IDE command approval priming. Dynamically discovers safe read-only commands in the current workspace, enforces the Subprocess Isolation Rule and 'No Spicy Prefixes' Command Boundary Law, confirms the proposed command list with you first, and executes discrete top-level run_command calls so you can click 'Always Allow' in one pass.
suggestedPrompts: Bootstrap safe read-only command approvals for this workspace
Discover safe QA and git inspection commands in this repo and prime Always Allow
Audit which read-only prefixes are safe to prime here without spicy commands
